CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness.
   C. Use Self- Awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Bible Story: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story:.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Creation of has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Creation of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Creation of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of.
   B. Say Healing of has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Healing of to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus.
   C. Say Jesus has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Easter 3.0? (1 mark)
   A. Say Easter 3.0 has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Easter 3.0 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Easter 3.0 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Easter 3.0.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing Values? (1 mark)
   A. Say Sharing Values has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing Values.
   C. Apply the teaching of Sharing Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Sharing Values to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sharing Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Responsibility Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prayer Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
